' ===================================================================== ' DEEP EXPORT - Parts, Features, Sketches, Sketch Geometry, Parameters ' iLogic rule - run from the top-level assembly (.iam) ' ' Every unique part file in the assembly (all levels) is exported ONCE. ' Output folder (next to the assembly): <AssemblyName>_DeepExport\ ' Parts.xml -> one row per part: size (bounding box), volume, ' mass, material, quantity in assembly, counts ' Features.xml -> every feature: type, Join/Cut/..., sketch used, ' extent (distance/angle/through all), size ' Sketches.xml -> every sketch: plane, shape, width x height, ' number of lines/circles/arcs, dimensions ' SketchGeometry.xml -> every line/circle/arc: length, diameter, ' radius, angle, position ' Parameters.xml -> every parameter (d0, d1, user params...): ' expression, value, which sketch dimension it is ' ' All lengths in mm, angles in degrees, volume in mm^3, mass in kg. ' =====================================================================
Sub Main() ' ---------------- Settings ---------------- Dim skipContentCenter As Boolean = True ' skip screws, nuts etc. from Content Center Dim exportFormat As String = "xml" ' "xml" or "csv" ' ------------------------------------------
Dim doc As Document = ThisDoc.Document If doc.DocumentType <> DocumentTypeEnum.kAssemblyDocumentObject Then MessageBox.Show("Please open an assembly (.iam) before running this rule.", _ "Deep Export", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Warning) Exit Sub End If
Dim asm As AssemblyDocument = CType(doc, AssemblyDocument) Dim asmName As String = System.IO.Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(asm.FullFileName) Dim baseFolder As String = System.IO.Path.GetDirectoryName(asm.FullFileName) If String.IsNullOrEmpty(baseFolder) Then baseFolder = "C:\Temp" Dim outFolder As String = System.IO.Path.Combine(baseFolder, asmName & "_DeepExport") If Not System.IO.Directory.Exists(outFolder) Then System.IO.Directory.CreateDirectory(outFolder)
Dim parts As New List(Of String) parts.Add(Row("Part", "Part Number", "Description", "Material", "Part Type", "Quantity", _ "Size X mm", "Size Y mm", "Size Z mm", "Volume mm3", "Mass kg", _ "Bodies", "Sketches", "Features", "Full Path"))
Dim feats As New List(Of String) feats.Add(Row("Part", "Feature", "Type", "Operation", "Sketch", "Extent", _ "Size", "Direction", "Feature Parameters", "Suppressed", "Health"))
Dim sketches As New List(Of String) sketches.Add(Row("Part", "Sketch", "Plane", "Shape", "Width mm", "Height mm", _ "Lines", "Circles", "Arcs", "Splines", "Ellipses", _ "Dimensions", "Dimension List", "Used By Features", "Constraint Status"))
Dim geo As New List(Of String) geo.Add(Row("Part", "Sketch", "Entity", "Type", "Size", "Length mm", "Diameter mm", _ "Radius mm", "Angle deg", "X1 mm", "Y1 mm", "X2 mm", "Y2 mm", "Construction"))
Dim pars As New List(Of String) pars.Add(Row("Part", "Parameter", "Kind", "Expression", "Value", "Units", _ "Sketch Dimension", "Comment"))
Dim count As Integer = 0 For Each refDoc As Document In asm.AllReferencedDocuments If refDoc.DocumentType <> DocumentTypeEnum.kPartDocumentObject Then Continue For Dim pd As PartDocument = CType(refDoc, PartDocument)
Dim isCC As Boolean = False Try : isCC = pd.ComponentDefinition.IsContentMember : Catch : End Try If skipContentCenter AndAlso isCC Then Continue For
Try ExportPart(asm, pd, parts, feats, sketches, geo, pars) count += 1 Catch ex As Exception parts.Add(Row(System.IO.Path.GetFileName(pd.FullFileName), "ERROR: " & ex.Message)) End Try Next
WriteTable(outFolder, "Parts", "Part", asm.FullFileName, parts, exportFormat) WriteTable(outFolder, "Features", "Feature", asm.FullFileName, feats, exportFormat) WriteTable(outFolder, "Sketches", "Sketch", asm.FullFileName, sketches, exportFormat) WriteTable(outFolder, "SketchGeometry", "Entity", asm.FullFileName, geo, exportFormat) WriteTable(outFolder, "Parameters", "Parameter", asm.FullFileName, pars, exportFormat)
MessageBox.Show("Exported " & count & " parts to:" & vbCrLf & outFolder, _ "Deep Export", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information) End Sub
' --------------------------------------------------------------------- ' One part file ' --------------------------------------------------------------------- Sub ExportPart(asm As AssemblyDocument, pd As PartDocument, _ parts As List(Of String), feats As List(Of String), sketches As List(Of String), _ geo As List(Of String), pars As List(Of String))
Dim def As PartComponentDefinition = pd.ComponentDefinition Dim partName As String = System.IO.Path.GetFileName(pd.FullFileName) Dim uom As UnitsOfMeasure = pd.UnitsOfMeasure
' ---------- Features ---------- ' also remembers which features use which sketch Dim featBySketch As New Dictionary(Of String, List(Of String))
For Each f As PartFeature In def.Features Dim o As Object = f Dim fType As String = Clean(f.Type.ToString(), "FeatureObject", "Object")
Dim op As String = "" Try : op = Clean(o.Operation.ToString(), "Operation") : Catch : End Try If fType = "Hole" Then op = "Cut"
Dim skName As String = "" Try skName = o.Profile.Parent.Name Catch Try : skName = o.Sketch.Name : Catch : End Try End Try If skName <> "" Then If Not featBySketch.ContainsKey(skName) Then featBySketch(skName) = New List(Of String) featBySketch(skName).Add(f.Name) End If
Dim extent As String = "" Try : extent = Clean(o.ExtentType.ToString(), "Extent") : Catch : End Try
Dim size As String = "" Try size = "Distance " & o.Extent.Distance.Expression Catch Try : size = "Angle " & o.Extent.Angle.Expression : Catch : End Try End Try If fType = "Hole" Then Try size = "Dia " & o.HoleDiameter.Expression & If(size <> "", ", " & size, "") Catch End Try End If If size = "" AndAlso extent <> "" Then size = extent
Dim dirn As String = "" Try : dirn = Clean(o.Extent.Direction.ToString(), "ExtentDirection") : Catch : End Try
' Parameters owned by the feature (fillet radius, chamfer size, ...) Dim fParams As New List(Of String) Try For Each p As Object In o.Parameters fParams.Add(p.Name & "=" & p.Expression) Next Catch End Try
Dim health As String = "" Try : health = Clean(f.HealthStatus.ToString(), "HealthStatus") : Catch : End Try
feats.Add(Row(partName, f.Name, fType, op, skName, extent, size, dirn, _ String.Join(" | ", fParams.ToArray()), f.Suppressed.ToString(), health)) Next
' ---------- Sketches ---------- Dim dimMap As New Dictionary(Of String, String) ' parameter name -> "Sketch1 / Diameter"
For Each sk As PlanarSketch In def.Sketches Dim plane As String = "" Try plane = sk.PlanarEntity.Name Catch plane = "Face / other" End Try
Dim nL As Integer = 0, nC As Integer = 0, nA As Integer = 0, nS As Integer = 0, nE As Integer = 0 Dim minX As Double = Double.MaxValue, minY As Double = Double.MaxValue Dim maxX As Double = Double.MinValue, maxY As Double = Double.MinValue Dim firstDia As Double = 0
' Lines For Each ln As SketchLine In sk.SketchLines Dim p1 As Point2d = Ln.StartSketchPoint.Geometry Dim p2 As Point2d = Ln.EndSketchPoint.Geometry If Not Ln.Construction Then nL += 1 Grow(minX, minY, maxX, maxY, p1.X, p1.Y, 0) Grow(minX, minY, maxX, maxY, p2.X, p2.Y, 0) End If geo.Add(Row(partName, sk.Name, "Line " & nL, "Line", "L " & N(Ln.Length * 10) & " mm", _ N(Ln.Length * 10), "", "", N(LineAngle(p1, p2)), _ N(p1.X * 10), N(p1.Y * 10), N(p2.X * 10), N(p2.Y * 10), Ln.Construction.ToString())) Next
' Circles For Each c As SketchCircle In sk.SketchCircles Dim cp As Point2d = c.CenterSketchPoint.Geometry If Not c.Construction Then nC += 1 If firstDia = 0 Then firstDia = c.Radius * 20 Grow(minX, minY, maxX, maxY, cp.X, cp.Y, c.Radius) End If geo.Add(Row(partName, sk.Name, "Circle " & nC, "Circle", "Dia " & N(c.Radius * 20) & " mm", _ "", N(c.Radius * 20), N(c.Radius * 10), "", _ N(cp.X * 10), N(cp.Y * 10), "", "", c.Construction.ToString())) Next
' Arcs For Each a As SketchArc In sk.SketchArcs Dim cp As Point2d = a.CenterSketchPoint.Geometry Dim ang As Double = a.SweepAngle * 180 / Math.PI If Not a.Construction Then nA += 1 Try Grow(minX, minY, maxX, maxY, a.StartSketchPoint.Geometry.X, a.StartSketchPoint.Geometry.Y, 0) Grow(minX, minY, maxX, maxY, a.EndSketchPoint.Geometry.X, a.EndSketchPoint.Geometry.Y, 0) Catch End Try End If geo.Add(Row(partName, sk.Name, "Arc " & nA, "Arc", "R " & N(a.Radius * 10) & " mm, " & N(ang) & " deg", _ N(a.Radius * 10 * a.SweepAngle), N(a.Radius * 20), N(a.Radius * 10), N(ang), _ N(cp.X * 10), N(cp.Y * 10), "", "", a.Construction.ToString())) Next
' Splines / ellipses (counted, size not exported) Try For Each s As SketchSpline In sk.SketchSplines If Not s.Construction Then nS += 1 Next Catch End Try Try For Each e As SketchEllipse In sk.SketchEllipses If Not E.Construction Then nE += 1 geo.Add(Row(partName, sk.Name, "Ellipse " & nE, "Ellipse", _ "Major R " & N(E.MajorRadius * 10) & ", Minor R " & N(E.MinorRadius * 10) & " mm", _ "", "", "", "", N(E.CenterSketchPoint.Geometry.X * 10), _ N(E.CenterSketchPoint.Geometry.Y * 10), "", "", E.Construction.ToString())) Next Catch End Try
Dim w As Double = 0, h As Double = 0 If maxX > minX Then w = (maxX - minX) * 10 If maxY > minY Then h = (maxY - minY) * 10
' Dimensions Dim dimList As New List(Of String) Dim nDims As Integer = 0 For Each dc As DimensionConstraint In sk.DimensionConstraints nDims += 1 Dim dType As String = Clean(dc.Type.ToString(), "DimConstraintObject", "Object") Try Dim prm As Parameter = dc.Parameter Dim driven As String = "" If dc.Driven Then driven = " (driven)" dimList.Add(prm.Name & "=" & prm.Expression & driven) dimMap(prm.Name) = sk.Name & " / " & dType & driven Catch End Try Next
Dim status As String = "" Try : status = Clean(sk.ConstraintStatus.ToString(), "ConstraintStatus") : Catch : End Try
Dim usedBy As String = "" If featBySketch.ContainsKey(sk.Name) Then usedBy = String.Join(", ", featBySketch(sk.Name).ToArray())
sketches.Add(Row(partName, sk.Name, plane, ShapeName(nL, nC, nA, nS, nE, w, h, firstDia), _ N(w), N(h), nL.ToString(), nC.ToString(), nA.ToString(), nS.ToString(), nE.ToString(), _ nDims.ToString(), String.Join(" | ", dimList.ToArray()), usedBy, status)) Next
' ---------- Parameters ---------- AddParams(partName, def.Parameters.ModelParameters, "Model", uom, dimMap, pars) AddParams(partName, def.Parameters.UserParameters, "User", uom, dimMap, pars) AddParams(partName, def.Parameters.ReferenceParameters, "Reference", uom, dimMap, pars)
' ---------- Part summary ---------- Dim sx As String = "", sy As String = "", sz As String = "" Try Dim b As Box = def.RangeBox sx = N((b.MaxPoint.X - b.MinPoint.X) * 10) sy = N((b.MaxPoint.Y - b.MinPoint.Y) * 10) sz = N((b.MaxPoint.Z - b.MinPoint.Z) * 10) Catch End Try
Dim vol As String = "", mass As String = "" Try vol = N(def.MassProperties.Volume * 1000) mass = N(def.MassProperties.Mass) Catch End Try
Dim mat As String = "" Try mat = pd.ActiveMaterial.DisplayName Catch mat = GetProp(pd.PropertySets, "Design Tracking Properties", "Material") End Try
Dim partType As String = "Standard" If TypeOf def Is SheetMetalComponentDefinition Then partType = "Sheet Metal"
Dim qty As String = "" Try : qty = asm.ComponentDefinition.Occurrences.AllReferencedOccurrences(pd).Count.ToString() : Catch : End Try
parts.Add(Row(partName, _ GetProp(pd.PropertySets, "Design Tracking Properties", "Part Number"), _ GetProp(pd.PropertySets, "Design Tracking Properties", "Description"), _ mat, partType, qty, sx, sy, sz, vol, mass, _ def.SurfaceBodies.Count.ToString(), def.Sketches.Count.ToString(), _ def.Features.Count.ToString(), pd.FullFileName)) End Sub
Sub AddParams(partName As String, coll As Object, kind As String, uom As UnitsOfMeasure, _ dimMap As Dictionary(Of String, String), pars As List(Of String)) Try For Each p As Object In coll Dim nm As String = "", expr As String = "", valStr As String = "", units As String = "", cmt As String = "" Try : nm = p.Name : Catch : End Try Try : expr = p.Expression : Catch : End Try Try : units = p.Units : Catch : End Try Try : valStr = uom.GetStringFromValue(p.Value, units) : Catch : End Try Try : cmt = p.Comment : Catch : End Try Dim skDim As String = "" If dimMap.ContainsKey(nm) Then skDim = dimMap(nm) pars.Add(Row(partName, nm, kind, expr, valStr, units, skDim, cmt)) Next Catch End Try End Sub
' --------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Helpers ' ---------------------------------------------------------------------
' Rough shape name from what the sketch contains Function ShapeName(nL As Integer, nC As Integer, nA As Integer, nS As Integer, nE As Integer, _ w As Double, h As Double, dia As Double) As String Dim other As Integer = nS + nE If nL = 0 AndAlso nA = 0 AndAlso other = 0 AndAlso nC = 1 Then Return "Circle Dia " & N(dia) If nL = 0 AndAlso nA = 0 AndAlso other = 0 AndAlso nC > 1 Then Return nC & " circles" If nC = 0 AndAlso nA = 0 AndAlso other = 0 Then If nL = 3 Then Return "Triangle" If nL = 4 Then Return "Rectangle / 4-sided " & N(w) & " x " & N(h) If nL > 4 Then Return "Polygon (" & nL & " sides)" If nL > 0 Then Return nL & " line(s)" End If If nL = 2 AndAlso nA = 2 AndAlso nC = 0 AndAlso other = 0 Then Return "Slot " & N(w) & " x " & N(h) If nL = 0 AndAlso nC = 0 AndAlso nA = 0 AndAlso other = 0 Then Return "Empty / points only" Return "Mixed profile (" & nL & " lines, " & nA & " arcs, " & nC & " circles" & _ If(other > 0, ", " & other & " splines/ellipses", "") & ")" End Function
Sub Grow(ByRef minX As Double, ByRef minY As Double, ByRef maxX As Double, ByRef maxY As Double, _ x As Double, y As Double, r As Double) If x - r < minX Then minX = x - r If y - r < minY Then minY = y - r If x + r > maxX Then maxX = x + r If y + r > maxY Then maxY = y + r End Sub
Function LineAngle(p1 As Point2d, p2 As Point2d) As Double Return Math.Atan2(p2.Y - p1.Y, p2.X - p1.X) * 180 / Math.PI End Function
' Number -> text, 3 decimals Function N(v As Double) As String Return Math.Round(v, 3).ToString() End Function
' "kExtrudeFeatureObject" -> "Extrude" Function Clean(s As String, ParamArray suffixes() As String) As String If s Is Nothing Then Return "" If s.StartsWith("k") Then s = s.Substring(1) For Each suf As String In suffixes If s.EndsWith(suf) Then s = s.Substring(0, s.Length - suf.Length) Exit For End If Next Return s End Function
Function GetProp(sets As PropertySets, setName As String, propName As String) As String If sets Is Nothing Then Return "" Try Dim v As Object = sets.Item(setName).Item(propName).Value If v Is Nothing Then Return "" Return v.ToString() Catch Return "" End Try End Function
' One row; fields joined with an invisible separator Function Row(ParamArray fields() As String) As String Dim q As New List(Of String) For Each f As String In fields If f Is Nothing Then f = "" q.Add(f.Replace(Chr(31), " ").Replace(vbCr, " ").Replace(vbLf, " ")) Next Return String.Join(Chr(31).ToString(), q.ToArray()) End Function
' Writes one table as XML or CSV. First row = column names. Sub WriteTable(folder As String, tableName As String, itemTag As String, source As String, _ rows As List(Of String), fmt As String) Dim sep As Char = Chr(31) Dim headers() As String = rows(0).Split(sep)
If fmt.ToLower() = "csv" Then ' ";" for German Excel Dim lines As New List(Of String) For Each r As String In rows Dim cells As New List(Of String) For Each v As String In r.Split(sep) cells.Add("""" & v.Replace("""", """""") & """") Next lines.Add(String.Join(";", cells.ToArray())) Next System.IO.File.WriteAllLines(System.IO.Path.Combine(folder, tableName & ".csv"), _ lines.ToArray(), System.Text.Encoding.UTF8) Exit Sub End If
For i As Integer = 0 To headers.Length - 1 headers(i) = TagName(headers(i)) Next
Dim sb As New System.Text.StringBuilder() sb.AppendLine("<?xml version=""1.0"" encoding=""utf-8""?>") sb.AppendLine("<" & tableName & " source=""" & Esc(source) & """ exported=""" & _ DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm") & """>") For r As Integer = 1 To rows.Count - 1 Dim vals() As String = rows(r).Split(sep) sb.AppendLine(" <" & itemTag & ">") For i As Integer = 0 To headers.Length - 1 Dim v As String = "" If i < vals.Length Then v = vals(i) sb.AppendLine(" <" & headers(i) & ">" & Esc(v) & "</" & headers(i) & ">") Next sb.AppendLine(" </" & itemTag & ">") Next sb.AppendLine("</" & tableName & ">")
System.IO.File.WriteAllText(System.IO.Path.Combine(folder, tableName & ".xml"), _ sb.ToString(), New System.Text.UTF8Encoding(False)) End Sub
' "Size X mm" -> "SizeXmm" Function TagName(header As String) As String Dim t As New System.Text.StringBuilder() For Each ch As Char In header If Char.IsLetterOrDigit(ch) Then t.Append(ch) Next Dim s As String = t.ToString() If s.Length = 0 OrElse Char.IsDigit(s(0)) Then s = "_" & s Return s End Function
' Escape & < > " ' for XML Function Esc(s As String) As String If s Is Nothing Then Return "" Return s.Replace("&", "&").Replace("<", "<").Replace(">", ">") _ .Replace("""", """).Replace("'", "'") End Function
